scope: Actual full32 physical core1674devices, all604HBT/512MOS native bounds, original34ns/256bits/three sampling phases. Wire mode includes all117251R77892C; compact mode excludes metal RC for diagnosis. Actual eleven clock reference/feed macros included. External schematic CMOS, ideal modulation and output frontends remain. No fullPHY/PVT/RF/substrate/mainchip acceptance.
clock_model_scope: All eleven actual six-device clock macros, each13R28C and finite body contacts. Modulation, supply, wire C reference and intermacro connections remain ideal boundaries; fullPHY/mainchip still open.

return_rail.scope: Final-column AVSS TM1 trunk widens64to128um and moves80um outward; local final AVSS TM1 strap widens4to6um while the2x2 topvia array retains its exact baseline geometry. Other column trunks, bottom bus width, child stubs/drawings, lower emitter vias, AVDD/SUB, signals, topology and devices stay unchanged. No resistance scaling or electrical claim.

timing_priority.meaning: 16/receiver stride is a geometry priority proxy, not measured delay. Original clocks, bit phases and electrical gates remain unchanged; every regressed leg requires fresh full-wave testing.

lexicographic_objectives: minimum weighted total length at fixed maximum

plan.scope: All60 original intermacro legs prioritized by receiver stride, with original16leaf/final fixed rows, macro X,600um separation/residues, children, devices, clocks and electrical gates preserved. Original global route ceiling remains; every regression against measured minimax routes is retained. DRC/LVS and fresh RC/fullwave must decide acceptance.

signals.method: All original source bits at unchanged 0.3/0.5/0.7 UI; 100mV limit. No fitted latency, resampling phase adjustment, or actual-input-derived oracle.

capture.method: Memory-mapped full binary raw; every original vector retained; no interpolation/decimation
